summary: X Financial filed a 6-K disclosing a preliminary non-binding proposal letter from Mangrove Coast Investment Limited to take the NYSE-listed company private. Mangrove, affiliated with Chairman/CEO Yue (Justin) Tang, holds ~93.45% of voting power and offers US$1.005 cash per ordinary share, or US$6.03 per ADS (six shares each), a 28.3% premium to the last close and 25.1% to the 30-day VWAP as of November 6, 2026. The board intends to form an independent special committee with financial and legal advisors; Tang will recuse. Watch minority-holder appraisal risk, committee independence, and whether any higher bid emerges given the dominant stake.
